notes: Restrained narration. No button names are spoken; current bindings are shown in subtitles/labels at runtime. Speakers map to Kokoro voices via hyperframes tts (local). Speed 1.0 unless noted.

lines.speaker: saeed
lines.text: Eleven countries. A passport full of stamps. One last stop before home.
lines.trigger: Prologue start, outside the Marrakech shop

lines.speaker: shopkeeper
lines.text: Welcome. Take your time. Everything in here has been somewhere.

lines.speaker: shopkeeper
lines.text: Ah, those. An optician's frames. Very old. The case came with them.

lines.speaker: shopkeeper
lines.text: A good choice. Keep them in the case until you are home. The hinges are tired.
lines.trigger: Payment token placed in the tray

lines.speaker: saeed
lines.text: Thank you. They're perfect.

lines.speaker: saeed
lines.text: Home.

lines.speaker: mother
lines.text: You're home? Good. Call me when you've unpacked.
lines.replay: can replay by tapping the phone

lines.speaker: saeed
lines.text: Let's see how you look.
lines.trigger: Player picks up the glasses at home

lines.speaker: saeed
lines.text: That wasn't there a second ago.
lines.trigger: Reflection shows a corridor that is not in the room

lines.speaker: saeed
lines.text: The passport. There's a seam in the page.

lines.speaker: tutorial
lines.text: Open your passport. Choose somewhere you remember.
lines.replay: waits for action; replayable from Controls page

lines.speaker: tutorial
lines.text: Pull the seam gently. A narrow opening is enough to look through.

lines.speaker: tutorial
lines.text: Light passes through. So can other things.

lines.speaker: tutorial
lines.text: Close the tear before it follows.
lines.trigger: Tutorial: seal / first hand at a seam

lines.speaker: tutorial
lines.text: Reach out and take it.

lines.speaker: tutorial
lines.text: Find what is genuine, and press the seal to it.

lines.speaker: tutorial
lines.text: Stay out of its reach. Light pushes it back.

lines.speaker: tutorial
lines.text: Wider lets more through. In both directions.

lines.speaker: tutorial
lines.text: Wide enough to step through. Go, while it holds.

lines.speaker: tutorial
lines.text: Take the glasses off now, and you wake where it began.

lines.speaker: saeed
lines.text: The sand is falling upward.

lines.speaker: saeed
lines.text: That shadow is pointing at the sun.

lines.speaker: saeed
lines.text: It's standing at the desk. Waiting for me.
lines.trigger: Arrive in Paris, Passenger at desk

lines.speaker: saeed
lines.text: It's coming through!
lines.trigger: Hand enters through a window-size tear
lines.replay: each time, max once per 30 s

lines.speaker: saeed
lines.text: Two arrivals. Under my name.

lines.speaker: saeed
lines.text: Shadows of people who aren't here.

lines.speaker: saeed
lines.text: Three reflections. Only one of them is honest.

lines.speaker: saeed
lines.text: There's someone extra in the reflection.

lines.speaker: saeed
lines.text: Everything is holding its breath. Except the drum.

lines.speaker: saeed
lines.text: One minute to midnight. It has been one minute to midnight for a while.

lines.speaker: saeed
lines.text: It's the shop. But the shelves don't end.

lines.speaker: optician
lines.text: Note one. The lenses remember every place the wearer has truly stood. They cannot invent a place. They can only copy one.
lines.trigger: Calibration insert placed in the glasses case

lines.speaker: optician
lines.text: Note two. Something lives in the copies. It cannot leave, unless someone carries it out under their own name.

lines.speaker: optician
lines.text: Note three. It forges what it cannot earn. A home stamp nobody issued. Never open that door.

lines.speaker: optician
lines.text: Calibrate against the true seals. The real way home is the one you can prove.

lines.speaker: saeed
lines.text: Eleven places. Twelve stamps. I never stamped this one.
lines.trigger: Counterfeit HOME seal appears in the passport
lines.replay: once per save; also judges' demo ending

lines.speaker: saeed
lines.text: Three doors that look like home. And a wall that doesn't.

lines.speaker: saeed
lines.text: Not the door that looks like home. The one you can prove is home.
lines.trigger: Genuine return revealed on the blank wall

lines.speaker: saeed
lines.text: Off. Get them off!

lines.speaker: saeed
lines.text: Home. Really home.

lines.speaker: mother
lines.text: Saeed? You didn't call. Call me when you can.

lines.speaker: saeed
lines.text: No. Not again.

lines.speaker: saeed
lines.text: The apartment. I'm back where it started.
